text:
Both summaries are accurate on the core facts: the 1,200 CFU/mL result, the 24-hour notification, the resample result, the $7,350 cost, the $4,800 approval decision, and the interim weekly checks. A has a small imprecision: it says the test "found" Legionella on 29 September, when the sample was taken that day and results arrived on 3 October. It also gives 9 October as the date the resample was taken rather than the date its result came back. B avoids these slips. It also includes the increased fortnightly sampling, which A omits, and it notes the contractor's missed visit went unreported. B leads with the decision the manager must make. Both run slightly past 120 words, so length does not separate them. B is more accurate and more complete at similar length.

Verdict: B
